title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Properly Handling Work Related to the Period Before the Implementation of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Management of Judicial Authentication
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of State Security, Ministry of Justice

Notice on Matters Concerning the Period Prior to the Implementation of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Administration of Judicial Expertise

No. 62 [2005] of the Ministry of Justice

To: the Higher People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), State Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and the People's Procuratorate, Public Security Bureau, and Justice Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Administration of Judicial Expertise (hereinafter referred to as the "Decision") was adopted and published by the Fourteenth Session of the Standing Committee of the Tenth National People's Congress on February 28, and shall come into effect on October 1. The Decision is an important legal basis for promoting the reform of the judicial expertise system and for regulating and strengthening the administration of judicial expertise. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, state security organs, and judicial administrative organs at all levels must earnestly study it, unify their understanding, strengthen communication, and closely cooperate. Under the unified deployment of the central authorities, preparations for the implementation of the Decision shall be carried out actively and steadily. During the transitional period between the publication and the implementation of the Decision, in light of the fact that the new judicial expertise administrative system needs to be gradually established and perfected, the role of existing judicial expertise resources shall be reasonably utilized. On the one hand, indiscriminate establishment of judicial expertise institutions that neglect actual needs and leads to disorderly development shall be prevented; on the other hand, a sharp decline in the capacity to provide judicial expertise services to society, or even a complete vacuum, shall also be prevented. It is necessary to establish an overall perspective, maintain the normal order of judicial expertise work, meet the needs of judicial organs, citizens, and organizations, ensure the smooth conduct of litigation activities, and create favorable conditions for the smooth implementation of the Decision. To this end, the following notice is hereby given:

1. Public security organs, procuratorial organs, and state security organs shall, strictly in accordance with the requirements of the Decision and under the unified deployment of their respective systems, actively and steadily advance the adjustment of existing expertise institutions and their functions, improve administrative mechanisms, and regulate expertise activities.

2. Judicial expertise institutions already established by people's courts and judicial administrative organs shall complete their adjustment by September 30 in accordance with the requirements of the Decision and the new administrative system. Specific measures and schedules shall be separately studied, formulated, and deployed for implementation by the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice. Before the adjustment measures are deployed and implemented, existing expertise institutions may continue to engage in judicial expertise business.

3. During the transitional period, the Ministry of Justice shall, in accordance with the Decision, revise and formulate as soon as possible the registration administrative measures for judicial expertise institutions and judicial expertise personnel serving the society. Based on the provisions of the two newly revised regulations, all localities shall complete, by September 30, the review of existing judicial expertise institutions and their expertise personnel in the categories of forensic medicine, material evidence, and audio-visual materials that have been registered with the judicial administrative organs and listed in the roster of people's courts. Those meeting the conditions shall be registered by the provincial judicial administrative organs according to their respective circumstances, a unified roster of judicial expertise institutions and judicial expertise personnel serving the society shall be compiled, and a public announcement shall be made. All types of existing expertise institutions that are temporarily not included in the unified administrative scope may continue to carry out relevant judicial expertise services. For judicial expertise businesses and expertise institutions that, based on the needs of litigation, need to be included in the unified administrative scope, the Ministry of Justice shall, in consultation with the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, determine them in accordance with the provisions of the Decision.

4. During the transitional period, if provincial judicial administrative organs, due to the fact that the existing scale, layout, and categories cannot meet the social demand for judicial expertise, truly need to newly approve judicial expertise institutions or supplement expertise personnel, the scope of expertise business they approve must fall within the categories of forensic medicine, material evidence, and audio-visual materials expertise that have been clearly stipulated by the Decision. The access conditions shall be implemented in accordance with the Decision and the revised registration administrative measures for judicial expertise institutions and judicial expertise personnel serving the society.

5. During the transitional period, all localities shall adopt effective measures to ensure the orderly conduct of judicial expertise work. All expertise business activities must strictly implement the current work procedures, work systems, technical standards, and professional ethics of judicial expertise, carry out expertise services in accordance with the law, and ensure the quality of expertise. The fees for judicial expertise services shall continue to follow the current local practices and standards, but the declaration of new expertise fee items and standards to relevant departments shall be stopped. All relevant departments shall, in accordance with the spirit of the central authorities' reform of the judicial system and the requirements of the Decision, strengthen coordination and cooperation, and jointly maintain the normal order of judicial expertise work during the transitional period.

6. All relevant departments shall attach great importance to the preparations for the implementation of the Decision, strengthen leadership, take the overall situation into account, closely cooperate, and actively and steadily advance and implement various tasks. The relevant central departments shall, on the basis of full investigation and research and coordinated efforts, successively formulate and issue supporting laws, regulations, and systems for the implementation of the Decision. All localities and relevant departments shall act in unison, strictly implement the unified deployment and relevant provisions, and shall not act independently.

7. During the transitional period, all localities and relevant departments shall establish a system for providing feedback on information regarding the implementation of the Decision. Any problems encountered in the process of implementing the spirit of the Decision and executing this Notice shall be promptly reported to the higher authorities, so that unified research, coordination, and resolution can be carried out. Under the unified deployment and guidance of the central authorities, it shall be ensured that all preparations for the implementation of the Decision proceed smoothly.

July 27, 2005
